cal.title: Calibration
cal.intro: Measures the room noise and your voice and suggests the gate threshold, noise reduction and gain. Takes 13 seconds.
cal.silence: 1/2 · Stay quiet, with the room as it usually is.
cal.speech: 2/2 · Read at a normal volume, as in a call:
cal.script: “Good morning, everyone. Today we will review the week's plan, see what is still pending and agree on each person's next steps.”
